latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of mapbox-mcp-devkit-patterns.

- Provides integration patterns for using Mapbox MCP DevKit Server with AI coding assistants.
- Covers setup, style management, token management, validation workflows, and documentation access.
- Includes recommended tooling, step-by-step pre-production validation and token management workflows.
- Offers references and resources for further guidance on best practices and troubleshooting.
